meaning: A meal you eat outside, often in a park.
mean_say: a meal you eat outside, often in a park.
example: We had a picnic under a big tree.
ex_say: We had a picnic under a big tree.
note: Stress on the 1st syllable. Both parts end in a "k" sound.
note_say: The stress is on the first syllable. Both parts end with a k sound.
tip: We say "have a picnic" or "go on a picnic".
tip_say: We say have a picnic, or go on a picnic.
vn_tip: Bật rõ âm /k/ cuối: “PIK-nik”, đừng nuốt mất âm /k/.
vn_tip_say: Say the K at the end clearly: pic, nic. Don't swallow it.
scene: A red checked blanket with a basket, fruit and lemonade under a leafy tree, as a butterfly flutters and leaves sway.
